titulo: Role of Mesenchymal Stem Cells in Microgravity Induced Bone Loss
extracto_verbatim: Exercise slows bone loss in microgravity but even when astronauts adopt a rigorous exercise regimen, they continue to lose about 1 - 2% of their bone mass a month.
